svg.aria-label: Current projects: ORION and Sentinel. Global UGRAD semi-finalist (2023–24). Oracle OCI AI Foundations certified. IBM courses: Istio & Kubernetes (×2). n8n + Canva pipeline: 90% less manual work
svg.text: My research playground. Vision models, time series
and knowledge graphs glued together with LangGraph
agents, so they can reason about factory sensors
and images at the same time.
MLOps on AWS/EKS that deploys models, watches them
for drift and rolls back on its own. Infrastructure
that doesn't need me awake. That's the plan.
n8n + Canva pipeline: 90% less manual work
